why: Reads 17 MediaPipe tracks + events from C:/Users/user/AppData/Local/Temp/FightCamp-footage on the operator's PC. Tools/footage/events and Tools/footage/ufc_pilot are EMPTY in a cloud container and 'find . -name *.npz' over the repo returns nothing, so this cannot be done from the cloud at any effort. Needs a PC session. NOTE before launching: add the shoulder-line yaw rate (deg/s, p50/p90) to the same pass - the bearing ruling wants it and the 17 tracks already carry it.
